# Cover assets

Prepare and generate the article cover package when the cover feature is enabled.

## Entry criteria

- The approved article has already been branded and split.

## Steps

- 22. Prepare the cover prompt `illustrate-prompt`
- 23. Generate the cover image `illustrate-google`
- 24. Describe the cover `describe-cover`

## Success signals

- A cover prompt, generated cover image, and editorial description exist.

## Exit criteria

- Cover assets are ready for final publication packaging.
